## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? Link related issues (e.g. Closes #123). -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature or technique (`feat:`)
- [ ] Breaking change (`feat!:` / `fix!:` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer)
- [ ] Performance (`perf:`)
- [ ] Refactor, tests, docs, build or CI (no release)

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (new technique: entry in `tests/fixtures/registry-boards.ts`)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm run check:package` and `npm run size` pass (if exports or build config changed)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, TSDoc) for public API changes
- [ ] Difficulty rating changes or breaking changes are described above
- [ ] No manual version bump or `CHANGELOG.md` edit (release-please handles this)
